en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by wooded hills. In the left foreground stands an ornate, turreted structure with pointed arches and decorative tile roof, described as a ruin, while below and to the right lie clustered houses, a main street with tram or rail tracks, and a small formal garden. The image is captioned in red Gothic-style script at the top.
